draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.45, the 17th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 4th of 10 at QB. He went 11th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Dak Prescott. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (96th percentile). College production: 2,100 passing yards in 2020, 8th of 10 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Kansas City Chiefs. 59 career games and 53 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 1 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 6 AV in 2025 against a career-best 16 in 2022. Strengths in 2025: interceptions thrown 1 (98th percentile). Weak spots: passing yards 1,259 (7th percentile), passing td 7 (10th percentile). Played 9 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-5 quarterback who played: 1,259 passing yards against a median of 1,226, above the norm.
